source_row.rationale: Sterilization destroys all forms of microbial life, including highly resistant bacterial spores, representing the highest level of microbial elimination — used for items requiring the highest level of safety (such as surgical instruments). Disinfection eliminates most pathogenic microorganisms but does not reliably destroy all bacterial spores, making it appropriate for a different category of items/surfaces based on their intended use and infection risk (per the Spaulding classification).
source_row.source_detail: CDC disinfection/sterilization guideline: sterilization destroys all microbial life including bacterial spores; accessed 2026-08-14.
